facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Outer Alster Lake in the St. Georg district.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the banks of the Outer Alster Lake in the trendy St. George district

facts.text: The hotel is within easy reach of the main station, the harbor and the UNESCO World Heritage sites Speicherstadt and Kontorhausviertel.
facts.excerpt: within easy reach of the main station and attractions like Hamburg's historic districts, trade fair grounds, the harbor, the UNESCO World Heritage sites Speicherstadt and Kontorhausviertel and the music halls

facts.text: The hotel has long been known as an art hotel, with art reflected throughout the building.
facts.excerpt: The hotel at the shores of Hamburg’s Alster Lake has been known to be an art hotel for a long time.

facts.text: Rooms use warm colors and a maritime design.
facts.excerpt: Chic is the style: Warm colors and a maritime design for our hotel rooms in Hamburg.

facts.text: Bathrooms have a separate shower and a Victorian-style bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms with a separate shower and a Victorian-style bathtub for full relaxation.

facts.text: Rooms have Malin + Goetz toiletries, bathrobes and slippers.
facts.excerpt: a cosmetic mirror, hairdryer, bathrobes, slippers, and Malin + Goetz toiletries

facts.text: The Prestige Lake Suite has panoramic views over the Alster Lake.
facts.excerpt: you'll be captivated by the breathtaking panoramic views over the expansive Alster Lake

facts.text: The Panorama Lake Suite is spread over two levels with sweeping Alster views.
facts.excerpt: Spread over two levels with an area of up to 74 m², this suite leaves nothing to be desired: Upon waking up, you'll be greeted by a sweeping view of the Alster

facts.text: Lake Suites can be expanded with additional rooms to sleep up to six guests.
facts.excerpt: With the option to expand the Lake Suite with additional rooms, you can require a generous oasis of up to 210 m² with space for up to six guests.

facts.text: Le SPA has a pool, sauna and steam bath.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our pool, sauna, and steam bath, perfect for enhancing your wellness experience.

facts.text: Le SPA is inspired by European spa traditions.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the rich traditions of European spa cultures

facts.text: Institute SK offers SHAZAY Hairspa rituals at Le SPA.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the luxurious SHAZAY Hairspa at Le SPA Hamburg

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Stay active 24/7 at Le Méridien Hamburg with modern equipment for all fitness levels and goals.

facts.text: HERITAGE restaurant serves classic cuisine reimagined with modern touches and subtle Asian accents.
facts.excerpt: Classic techniques form the foundation, reimagined with modern touches and subtle Asian accents

facts.text: The two-storey HERITAGE rooftop bar has an outdoor terrace with views over the Alster Lake and the city center.
facts.excerpt: The two storey rooftop bar with outdoor terrace offers a unique view over the Alster lake and Hamburg’s city center.

facts.text: Guests get complimentary admission to the Deichtorhallen contemporary art museum through Unlock Art.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the local culture with complimentary access to the Deichtorhallen museum through our Unlock Art™ program.

facts.text: A 7.4 km jogging trail circles the Alster Lake, steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a refreshing jog around the picturesque Alster Lake, just steps from our hotel. The 7.4 km trail offers stunning views

facts.text: The Käpt'n Prüsse sailing school is located opposite the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located opposite the hotel, this renowned school offers courses for all skill levels.

facts.text: Bicycle rental is complimentary.
facts.excerpt:
Bicycle Rental

Complimentary

facts.text: Dogs staying at the hotel receive their own dog bed and food bowls.
facts.excerpt: Your furry friend will receive their own dog bed (available in small or large sizes) and food bowls.

facts.text: Cash payment is not possible anywhere in the hotel; major credit cards are accepted.
facts.excerpt: Please note that cash payment is not possible throughout the hotel. We accept all major credit cards for payment.

facts.text: Connecting room options are available.
facts.excerpt: Connecting room options available. Travel together and enjoy privacy.

facts.text: HERITAGE restaurant floor.
facts.excerpt: On the 9th floor overlooking the Alster, HERITAGE celebrates timeless culinary craft.

facts.excerpt: choose from a variety of newly renovated guest rooms with modernly designed interiors
